Introduction

Pocket Girls is a three-member girl group consisting of models Yeonji, Hanbin, and Minchae. Formed by MissDica Entertainment, they debuted as a four-member group on April 10, 2015 with the song "Bbang, Bbang". The original lineup consisted of Sea, Soyoon, Yeonji, and Jua. Created with the intention of promoting the company's racecar models, the group underwent multiple lineup changes throughout their active years.
